caption: The drawing depicts a single, full-length dress displayed without a visible mannequin or body inside. The dress is primarily off-white or light cream in color, with a pattern of small, scattered floral motifs in shades of blue, yellow, green, and red. The design features short, puffed sleeves with ruffled edges, a fitted bodice, and a wide, wrap-around sash tied at the waist, with the ends of the sash hanging down at the front. The skirt is gathered at the waist and falls to the floor with a slight outward flare, and the hem is finished with a wide band. The background of the drawing is plain and uncolored.
title: Girl's Dress
